members.name: content
members.doc: What the tooltip says. It is required, and a blank string does not count.

members.name: trigger
members.doc: The focusable element the tooltip describes.

members.name: delay
members.doc: How long a hover waits before the tooltip opens, in milliseconds. Keyboard focus opens it at once.

members.name: closeDelay
members.doc: How long the tooltip stays open after the pointer leaves, in milliseconds.

members.name: placement
members.doc: Where the tooltip opens against its trigger or anchorRef. start and end follow the locale direction.

members.name: offset
members.doc: The distance in pixels between the tooltip and its trigger, along the placement's side.

members.name: crossOffset
members.doc: The shift in pixels along the side the tooltip is placed against.

members.name: shouldFlip
members.doc: Whether the tooltip moves to the opposite side when the placed side has no room.

members.name: containerPadding
members.doc: The least distance in pixels between the tooltip and the edge of the viewport. Must not be negative.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the tooltip is open, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the tooltip starts open, when it controls itself.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the tooltip: it does not open, and an open one closes. The trigger stays operable.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Reports the tooltip opening or closing.
